name: Luxembourg
tagline: One multilingual university, and a compulsory semester abroad
summary: Luxembourg has one public university, founded in 2003, where many bachelor's degrees are taught in two languages and every bachelor student spends a semester abroad. There is one intake a year, in September, and applications for 2027 open on 1 February 2027. Language, not points, is what decides whether a programme is open to you.
whyConsider: A small, well-funded university at the centre of EU institutions and international finance.
A semester abroad is built into every bachelor's degree.
In 2026 some programmes stayed open to EU applicants until after IB results, so you could apply on real grades rather than predicted ones.
watchOuts: You must prove every teaching language of your programme. English alone is often not enough.
Each programme sets its own closing date. Check your programme's admissions page, not a university-wide date.
Sacred Heart University's Luxembourg campus and the BBI hospitality school, still listed on many study-abroad sites, are not options: one closed and the other's website no longer exists.
Luxembourg is one of the most expensive places in the EU to rent.

sectorLandscape.summary: Luxembourg higher education is small: the Université du Luxembourg is the only public university, lycées run two-year BTS programmes, and the ministry lists just two specialised private institutions with accredited programmes, LUNEX and the Luxembourg School of Business.

routes.what: The only public university. Three-year bachelor's degrees, often bilingual, with a compulsory semester abroad. Eligibility depends on your nationality, residence and where your diploma is from.
routes.note: The IB is not named on the university's admission criteria page; its eligibility checker decides each case.

routes.what: Two-year, 120-ECTS vocational higher education run by secondary schools (lycées), in commerce, health, industry, applied arts, crafts and services. 36 programmes, each with its own registration period.
routes.note: The ministry's page gives neither the teaching language nor whether a foreign diploma gives access. Not researched further.

routes.what: Private institutions with ministry-accredited programmes: LUNEX in Differdange (physiotherapy, sport and health, taught in English) and the Luxembourg School of Business. They charge private tuition.
routes.note: LUNEX asks for a university entrance qualification and English at B2, and takes applications all year.

notes: Removed from the institution list on 2026-09-23: Sacred Heart University Luxembourg (shu.lu is a parked domain; campus reported closed July 2022) and BBI (bbi-edu.eu now serves a gambling page). Neither is on the ministry's accredited list.

Not established: University of Luxembourg tuition and application fee (uni.lu fee pages not read), IB-specific entry rules, and whether BTS programmes admit foreign-diploma holders or teach in English.
The Luxembourg School of Business is named in the sector landscape but not added to the institution list: whether it offers a bachelor's degree was not checked.
